architecture.accumulated_bias: arithmetic mean of local scores over the complete declared anchor prefix
architecture.deployment_scope: add a positive scaled accumulated bias only to the ephemeral virtual-logit suffix after the current anchor contributes; real-key logits and mask bytes stay exact
architecture.name: causal_prefix_depth_accumulated_routed_virtual_kv
architecture.runtime_state: ephemeral per-forward running score sum and count; no persistent cache mutation

candidate_bank.distractors: Take the minimum source index from the first two lexicographically sorted retrieval donor pairs other than the target/donor pair.
candidate_bank.layer_permutation: At every component of the anchor prefix, score the target query against the target address rolled forward by one over the complete ordered 42-module axis before applying that component's frozen map.
candidate_bank.zero_probe: Replace every address in the active anchor prefix with exact all-zero 64-vectors; every local score and the accumulated bias must be exact zero, and slot eligibility must be false.
